dedupe_keys.name: desalinated water produced in swcc plants

description: Desalinated Water Produced in SWCC Plants is a dataset listed in KAPSARC Data Portal, an energy economics open data portal, published or maintained by King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC). This dataset contains Saudi Arabia Desalinated Water Produced in SWCC Plants for 2013-2019 Data from Electricity and Cogeneration Regulatory Authority. Follow datasource.kapsarc.org for timely data to advance energy economics research. In Million Cubic Meter. Table (24) In True.pdf in the attachments. Chapter Five: Seawater Desalination (p.133) in StatisticalBooklet2019 in the attachments. Coverage: as titled: Saudi Arabia, the Gulf states, India or the world (see the dataset page). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Water & Agriculture. Its keywords are Desalinated water, SWCC Plants, Water. The portal shows 2023-02-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public Domain. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy, water and transport system studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kapsarc-open-data-portal.
